findings.issue: Lead hook 'Truth Social launches on a closed market' and intro 'led by Trump's Truth Social launch' read as a completed launch; the App Store release came after the 00:00 UTC 21 February cutoff and was only scheduled (Reuters n0932, Axios n1766).
findings.resolution: Hook changed to 'Truth Social's launch is set for a holiday'; intro and Why Retail Is Here now say the launch is set/due for Presidents' Day; When the Narrative Breaks now reads 'whatever Monday's launch delivers' instead of presupposing a launch and its reception.

findings.issue: Note claimed DWAC/Truth Social was never an earlier lead or smaller item, but the 17 February edition ran DWAC as a smaller item ('Truth Social's first screenshot'); the lead recycled that item's headlines (Forbes screenshot n1722, Newsweek look-alike n1723, Time n0403) and the 17-18 February Munger/Saluzzi items (n1721, n1737).
findings.resolution: Recycled headlines removed except Bloomberg's Parler/Gettr item; lead rebuilt on newly published evidence (Slate n1763, Guardian beta n1752, Vanity Fair n1744, NYT n1767, CNBC n0844, Bloomberg options hedge n2043) around the new holiday-gap angle; note corrected with the 17 February relation.

findings.issue: Item 'digital gold flunks the weekend war test' repeated the 18 February smaller item 'digital gold fails the war test' (same gold-versus-bitcoin angle) without a new narrative.
findings.resolution: Re-angled to 'the dip-buyers meet Buterin's winter' on new 18-19 February evidence (Bloomberg n1001, Business Insider Africa n1762, ADWEEK n0995); gold comparison and the 14 February Super Bowl items (n0360, n0086, n2045) dropped; Ether's 17.33% labelled as a five-session move.

findings.issue: Third gold-hedge item in a week (GDX 14 February, GLD 17 February) presented as a full material update with the same invasion-hedge angle; it also relied on the Guardian Macron summit item n1430, whose summit-in-principle announcement may post-date the cutoff, consistent with the writer's own avoidance of n1427/n1440.
findings.resolution: Demoted to a brief secondary carryover of 154 words citing only new weekend evidence (n1424, n1422, n1435, n0834); n1430 and the Barrick item removed; the timing sentence now attaches 'yet to trade' to the Sunday Belarus extension.

findings.issue: NPR Boombox recall (n1866) carries a 17 February index stamp but reports the recall announced on 10 February, outside the seven-day company-news window.
findings.resolution: Replaced with Time's 16 February 'latest scandals could hurt its bottom line' (n1834).

findings.issue: Avis meme-stock headline attributed to 'Business Insider' (src is Business Insider Africa) and mechanically weak as a DWAC analog.
findings.resolution: Removed; analog now rests on the Virgin Galactic round trip with CNBC n0844 for the board exit and Forbes n0903 for the crash framing.

findings.issue: Social Signal mixed leverage evidence into attention evidence; Smart Money View leaned on generic Munger/rebellion commentary.
findings.resolution: Social Signal limited to attention coverage with a modal inference; Smart Money View now names a business split (NYT vs Parler/Gettr CEOs) and a positioning split (Bloomberg crash hedge, Wolf Street leverage).

scope_limits: Headlines only, not article bodies; feed timestamps are day-granular (08:00 UTC), so timing was judged from event knowledge strictly before 00:00 UTC 21 February. Numbers checked against cards/2022-02-21.json (US sessions 18 February; crypto 20 February). The Truth Social launch outcome, Putin's 21 February recognition and anything later were not used.

recommended_exclusions.reason: CNN 'Photos: Russia invades Ukraine' stamped 14 February: misdated or mischaracterised; no invasion had occurred at this cutoff.
CNN/CNBC Biden agrees 'in principle' to meet Putin: White House statement issued around or after 00:00 UTC 21 February.
CNN White House statement on a Biden-Putin meeting in principle: same timing risk as n1427.
Guardian Macron paves way for Putin-Biden summit: reports the summit-in-principle announcement made around midnight UTC; timing doubtful.
NPR Tesla Boombox recall: a 10 February event indexed 17 February; stale company news for this date.
